about_the_game:
Free single player Demo Available.

Embark on Horror Simulator VR: Part 1, where you'll experience the first map in depth with multiplayer!

Don't forget to wishlist the game and be ready for more thrilling adventures!

Horror Simulator VR is a thrilling multiplayer horror game that combines survival horror and strategic gameplay. Features 3 completed maps, 2 game modes, 10+ unique demon types, 50+ supernatural events... more content continuously updating!

🏰 Solo/Multiplayer Adventure in Haunted Mansion

  • Solo or 3-player co-op. Real-time voice chat allows you to stay in close communication with your teammates, share clues, and devise strategies.

  • Customize avatar: Unlock a variety of masks, skins, and decorations. Cosmetics designs are player-driven - join Discord to share your ideas!

🕸 Immersive Puzzle-Solving & Exploration

  • 10+ demon types, each with unique personality and behavior. Every round features a new demon, ensures every playthrough brings fresh challenges.

  • Use 7 sacramentals to to solve challenging puzzles and reveal the demon’s name.

  • 3 maps with 50+ unique, fully interactive rooms. Each exploration may uncover crucial clues or trigger unexpected supernatural events!

  • Take on daily, weekly and in-game tasks to earn coins and unlock cosmetics and in-game items.

🏃 Classic & Crazy Mode

  • Demons will do everything to scare you off. When your sanity plummets, demons will initiate hunt mode.

  • In Crazy Mode, demons possess special abilities, making teamwork and strategy crucial for victory!

Dare to venture forth?

name: Horror Simulator VR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA®GeForce® GTX 1650s / AMD Radeon™ RX5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR，requires motion controllers. Support Valve Index, Quest 2 and Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA®GeForce® GTX 1650s / AMD Radeon™ RX5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR，requires motion controllers. Support Valve Index, Oculus Rift, Rift s, Quest, Quest 2 and Quest 3, Pico Neo 3, Pico 4, Pico 4 pro
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
